nws_alerts.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued November 19 at 9:33AM MST until November 21 at 11:00AM MST by NWS Salt Lake City UT
nws_alerts.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 12 and 24
inches, highest in the Upper Cottonwoods and for mountains near the
Utah/Idaho border.

* WHERE...The Wasatch Mountains.

* WHEN...Until 11 AM MST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Winter driving conditions are expected. Roads, and
especially bridges and overpasses, will likely become slick and
hazardous.

nws_alerts.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued November 19 at 1:06PM MST until November 21 at 5:00AM MST by NWS Pocatello ID
nws_alerts.description:
* WHAT...Heavy snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 10 and
20 inches.

* WHERE...Big Hole Mountains and Bear River Range.

* WHEN...From 5 PM this afternoon to 5 AM MST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult.

discussion.key_messages: - A Pacific Northwest storm system will bring periods of snow to Utah's mountains through early Saturday, increasingly focused over northern Utah as time goes on. Significant snow accumulations will bring travel difficulties to high elevations routes. Snow levels will drop to northern Utah valley floors Friday night, bringing a chance of accumulating snow. - Freezing temperatures are increasing in probability for the Virgin River corridor near Zion National Park Saturday and Sunday mornings. - Dry conditions are expected over the weekend before a weaker system impacts primarily southern Utah Monday into Tuesday. An active pattern is expected to continue for the remainder of the upcoming week.
